extraction_notes: Multi-variant datasheet covering S3AF through S3MF (Zhuhai Hongjiacheng Technology co., Ltd, www.ichjc.com); S3MF column values used: VRRM=1000V, VRMS=700V, VDC=1000V (page 1).

Key maximum ratings (page 1): IF(AV)=3.0A at 60Hz sinewave resistance load, IFSM=80.0A at t=8.3ms half-sine, Tstg=-55 to +150degC, Tj=-55 to +150degC, RthJA=70degC/W and RthJL=16degC/W on 5.0mm x 5.0mm copper pads. Package SMAF, cathode band marks cathode.
Second reverse leakage spec not representable in the single reverse_current slot: IR=500uA maximum at VR=VDC, Ta=125degC (page 2).
No reverse recovery time is specified anywhere in the datasheet (standard/glass-passivated rectifier), so reverse_recovery is null.

No explicit breakdown voltage or breakdown test current is specified; Fig.4 (typical reverse characteristics) shows a sharp avalanche knee at approximately 128-130% of rated VRRM (about 1280-1300V for S3MF), but this is a typical percent-of-rated curve, not a guaranteed spec, so breakdown fields are null.

Curves digitized manually from a 200 dpi rasterization of page 2 (Fig.1-Fig.4); reading uncertainty approximately +/-0.02V on Fig.3 voltages, +/-2A on Fig.2 currents, and roughly +/-15% on Fig.4 log-axis current values.

Fig.4 reverse-current curves apply family-wide as percent of rated VRRM; converted to absolute volts for S3MF multiply x-values by 10 (100% = 1000V). The near-vertical breakdown region above 120% was not digitized because x-resolution there is unreliable.
Fig.2 surge curve is family-wide (single curve for all variants), 8.3ms single half sine wave, JEDEC method.
